title: 第5章  逆天阳册，接连突破
slug: 让你当炉做鼎你炼阴阳证大道
content_zh:
“可恶，可恶！”
“李寒山，我一定要杀了你！”
又是一个时辰之后，李寒山刚走，花弄影的俏脸之上便浮起一层寒霜，眸中怒火翻涌。
这几天下来，她的伤还没好，修为也还没有恢复呢，结果李寒山又来把她给采了一次。
“对了，你这院子怎么出去？”
李寒山突然折返。
花弄影神色一僵，随即眉眼间又重新堆起笑意，递出一块令牌：“这是出入令牌，主人将其佩戴在身上即可。”
“好。”
李寒山接过令牌，转身离开。
“倒是会挑地方。”
李寒山走出院子，打量着周边的环境。
花弄影这院子背倚竹林，一侧有瀑布飞流而下，周边开满鲜花，美不胜收。
远处山峦叠嶂，云雾缭绕，隐约可见雕梁画栋的亭台楼阁掩映其间。偶尔有几道遁光掠过天际，想来是合欢宗的弟子在御空飞行。
他来到一块石头后方，将衣服撩起，运转阳册功法。腹部，一个似花非花的淡金色纹路浮现了出来。
这是在与花弄影行事的过程中出现的。
“看来是阳册功法带来的，应该有一些用途。”
一番观察后，他放下衣服，放下了心来。
......
接下来的日子，李寒山每隔几天便会来找花弄影“修行”一次。
如果不是身体不太行，他都准备天天来找花弄影。

“这阳册功法，还真是逆天！”
借助阳册功法，没过多久，李寒山便突破了炼气二层。
“该死！他又突破了！”
察觉到李寒山突破时，花弄影脸上挂着惊喜的笑容，心里的怒火却要烧穿五脏六腑。
这可是她的修为啊。
被李寒山这样吸下去，别说筑基了，她能稳住当前的境界就不错了。
更让她心惊的是腹部的纹路——随着李寒山每一次“修行”，那纹路都在不断加深。从最初若隐若现的几笔勾勒，到现在已经能清晰地看出花瓣的形状。
一番思量后，花弄影有了计较。
下一次李寒山来找她时，她主动开口了。
“主人，您知道吗？宗门里有不少人都在打您的主意呢。”她一边为他揉着肩膀，一边语气温柔地开口，“虽然现在有奴家护着您，但奴家毕竟只是个内门弟子，万一哪天有金丹长老看上了您......”
她故意把话只说一半，留给李寒山自己想象。
“所以呢？”李寒山闭着眼享受着她的服侍，语气平静。
“所以主人应该让奴家先提升一下修为。”花弄影的声音愈发温柔，“奴家若是能突破筑基，不仅能成为核心弟子，还能得到宗门的重点培养，到那时，就算是金丹长老想动您，也得掂量掂量。”
“筑基？”李寒山睁开眼，似笑非笑地看着她，“你是想说，我应该全力助你突破筑基，然后你再保护我？”
花弄影心中一紧，脸上却露出委屈的表情：“主人，奴家只是担心您的安全......再说了，有心魔誓约在，就算奴家筑基了，也还是主人的小女奴呀。”
“是么。”李寒山淡淡道，“这件事后面再说吧。”
她不提还好，一提，他便本能的感觉，一定不能让她到筑基，否则肯定会发生不好的事。
花弄影还想再劝，李寒山却已经站起身来。
“今天就这样。你好好休息。”
他扔下这句话，头也不回地走了。

花弄影看着他的背影，脸上的温柔一点一点碎裂。
“老狐狸！”
她咬紧牙关，在心里把李寒山骂了个狗血淋头。她铺垫了这么久，这家伙居然一点不上当。
“主人，翠儿来访。”
“哦？让他进来。”
第二天，花弄影迎来了一个访客。
那是一个身穿青色衣裙的丫鬟，花弄影在院子里接见了她。
丫鬟到来后，先是行了一礼，随即道：“花师姐，主人听闻师姐买了一个纯阳圣体的炉鼎，特意遣婢子来瞧瞧。方才婢子瞧见，那老鼎......还活着？”
花弄影吐出一口烟雾，轻描淡写地道：“是还活着，这老鼎本仙子暂时还舍不得弄死。毕竟一百岁的纯阳圣体，稀罕得很，慢慢养着，说不定还能采出些别的好处来。”
翠儿沉默了一瞬，又行了一礼：“婢子知道了。那婢子这就回去复命。”
“去吧。”
翠儿退出了院子。
“她是谁？”
翠儿一走，李寒山便从房内走出，问。
“她是谁？”他走到院中，在花弄影对面坐下，状若无意地问。
“翠儿，圣女身边的侍女。”花弄影抿了口茶，语气轻描淡写。
“圣女？”李寒山眉头微挑，顺着话头往下探，“说起来，你之前提过，你那采补功法是宗门秘法。这秘法，莫非就是圣女传的？”
“自然是圣女。”提到这个，花弄影的语气里多了几分真心实意的敬重，“这可是祖师传下的无上秘法，寻常弟子连名字都听不到。我当年刚入内门，被人排挤得厉害，若不是圣女帮我，我早就被人啃得连骨头都不剩了。”
她说这话时，眼中闪烁着一丝发自内心的感激。
李寒山却没有接话。

祖师的无上秘法？
与花弄影双修多次，他比任何人都清楚那门功法的霸道。
每一次采补，都恨不得将炉鼎的精元吸得一滴不剩。他在合欢宗也待了些时日了，知道其他妖女采补炉鼎，讲究的是细水长流，控制火候，好让炉鼎多撑些时日，多产些好处。可花弄影这门功法，却根本不讲究这些——它只管吸，往死里吸。
当然，这功法再霸道，也不如阳册霸道。
但这等秘法，合欢宗的圣女居然会给花弄影，这里面莫不是有什么道道？
具体是什么情况，李寒山就不清楚了。
接下来一些天，合欢宗圣女没有再派人来，花弄影也不再提她。
至于李寒山，他仍是每隔几天就找花弄影修行。
在这个过程中，他开始探索阳册功法的深度运用，肯定了腹部出现的神秘纹路跟阳册功法有关。
“她的纹路是凹纹，我的则是凸纹，凹为阴，凸为阳，她似乎看不到我腹部的纹路......”
李寒山的发现不少，比如两种纹路的区别，再比如这纹路随着修行次数的增加在不断加深。
另一个发现是，阳册功法汲取而来的能量，除了用来提升修为外，还可以用来滋养身体，效果比起花弄影的药汤还要更好。
这让他找花弄影的次数，变得更频繁一些了。
“该死！该死！李寒山，我一定要杀了你！”
每次李寒山一走，花弄影脸上温柔的笑容便像融化的冰雪一样垮塌下来，她抓起枕头狠狠摔在床上，银牙咬得咯咯作响。
她恨啊！
李寒山这边，连续多日的修行下来，体内的灵力如同被不断添柴的炉火，越烧越旺。
终于，在这一天夜里，丹田之中传来一声沉闷的轰鸣。那股积蓄已久的灵力突破了某个临界点，在他经脉中奔涌如潮，一路冲开了更广阔的周天循环。
炼气三层！
他睁开眼，眸中掠过一抹惊喜。

“这阳册，当真是逆天！”
李寒山愈发体会到了阳册功法的逆天。
彼之蜜饯，我之砒霜。
别人的灵力，如果直接吸入自己的体内，只会带来破坏。
所有的采补功法，在本质上，都是通过特殊的方式，将别人的灵力转化成自己的。
越好的功法，转化的效率就越高。
显然，阳册是属于最高的那种。
当然，阳册本质上是反掠夺的，只是也可以用来掠夺，就像李寒山现在做的这样。
“他又突破了！”
花弄影心里那个苦啊。
就算是采补，李寒山这修为突破的速度也太快了一点。
这让她郁闷的同时，内心深处对李寒山所怀的功法更加心热了，愈发想要得到它。
只是，李寒山继续这样吸下去，她永远别想突破筑基了，这让她越来越着急。
“不行，不能这样下去了。”
花弄影心知必须要找到破局的办法。
但有心魔誓约在，她还真不敢有其它举动。
content_en:
"Damn it, damn it!"
"Li Hanshan, I must kill you!"
Another hour later, as soon as Li Hanshan left, a layer of frost appeared on Hua Nongying's pretty face, and anger surged in her eyes.
In the past few days, her injury had not healed and her cultivation had not recovered yet. As a result, Li Hanshan came to pick her up again.
"By the way, how do you get out of your yard?"
Li Hanshan suddenly turned back.
Hua Nongying's expression froze, and then she smiled again and handed out a token: "This is the access token. The master can just wear it on his body."
"Okay."
Li Hanshan took the token and turned to leave.
"I know how to choose a place."
Li Hanshan walked out of the yard and looked at the surrounding environment.
The courtyard of Huarongying is backed by a bamboo forest, with a waterfall flowing down one side, and the surrounding area is full of flowers, which is so beautiful.
In the distance, there are mountains and mountains, shrouded in clouds and mist, and pavilions and pavilions with carved beams and painted buildings can be seen vaguely among them. Occasionally, there are a few rays of light passing through the sky. It seems that they are disciples of the Hehuan Sect flying in the sky.
He came behind a stone, lifted up his clothes, and performed the Yang Book technique. On the abdomen, a light golden pattern that looked like a flower but not a flower emerged.
This appeared in the process of acting with Hua Nongying.
"It seems that it was brought about by Yang Ce Kung Fu, and it should have some uses."
After some observation, he put down his clothes and felt relieved.
...
In the following days, Li Hanshan would come to Hua Nongying to "practice" every few days.
If he hadn't been in poor health, he would have been prepared to come see Hua Nongying every day.
"This Yang Ce Kung Fu is truly heaven-defying!"
With the help of Yang Ce Kung Fu, it didn't take long for Li Hanshan to break through the second level of Qi Refining.
"Damn it! He broke through again!"
When she noticed Li Hanshan's breakthrough, Hua Nongying had a smile of surprise on her face, but the anger in her heart was burning through her internal organs.
This is her cultivation level.
Being sucked in like this by Li Hanshan, let alone building a foundation, it would be good if she could stabilize her current state.
What frightened her even more was the lines on her abdomen—with every "practice" Li Hanshan did, the lines continued to deepen. From the first few vague outlines, the shape of the petals can now be clearly seen.
After thinking about it for a while, Hua Nongying came up with a plan.
The next time Li Hanshan came to see her, she took the initiative to speak.
"Master, do you know? There are many people in the sect who are trying to figure you out." She rubbed his shoulders and spoke softly, "Although the slave family is protecting you now, the slave family is only an inner disciple after all. What if Elder Jindan takes a fancy to you one day..."
She deliberately only said half of the words and left it to Li Hanshan's own imagination.
"So?" Li Hanshan closed his eyes and enjoyed her service with a calm tone.
"So the master should let the slave family improve their cultivation level first." Hua Nongying's voice became gentler. "If the slave family can break through the foundation building, not only can they become core disciples, but they can also receive key training from the sect. By then, even if Elder Jindan wants to touch you, he will have to think twice."
"Foundation Establishment?" Li Hanshan opened his eyes and looked at her with a half-smile, "You want to say that I should try my best to help you break through Foundation Establishment, and then you protect me?"
Hua Nongying's heart tightened, but a look of grievance appeared on her face: "Master, the slave family is just worried about your safety... Besides, with the inner demon's oath, even if the slave family has established a foundation, she is still the master's little slave girl."
"Really." Li Hanshan said lightly, "Let's talk about this later."
It was okay if she didn't mention it. Once she mentioned it, he instinctively felt that she must not be allowed to build the foundation, otherwise something bad would definitely happen.
Hua Nongying wanted to persuade her again, but Li Hanshan had already stood up.
"That's it for today. Have a good rest."
He dropped these words and left without looking back.
Hua Nongying looked at his back, the tenderness on her face breaking bit by bit.
"Old fox!"
She gritted her teeth and cursed Li Hanshan bloody in her heart. She had been laying the groundwork for so long, but this guy didn't fall for it at all.
"Master, Cui Er is here to visit. "
"oh? Let him in. "
The next day, Hua Nongying received a visitor.
It was a maid in a blue dress. Hua Nongying met her in the yard.
After the maid arrived, she bowed first and then said: "Senior Sister Hua, the master heard that Senior Sister bought a pure Yang Holy Body cauldron, so he sent his maid here to have a look. Just now, the maid saw that the old tripod... was still alive? "
Hua Nongying exhaled a puff of smoke and said lightly: "He is still alive, and this old Dingben fairy is reluctant to kill him for the time being. After all, a hundred-year-old pure Yang holy body is very rare. If you keep it slowly, you might be able to get some other benefits. "
Cui'er was silent for a moment, then bowed again: "My maid understands. The maid will go back and resume her life now. "
"Go ahead. "
Cui Er exited the yard.
"Who is she? "
As soon as Cui'er left, Li Hanshan walked out of the room and asked.
"Who is she? "He walked to the courtyard, sat down opposite Hua Nongying, and asked casually.
"Tui'er, the maid beside the saint. "Hua Nongying took a sip of tea and spoke in an understatement.
"Saint? Li Hanshan raised his brows slightly and followed the words, "Speaking of which, you mentioned before that your tonic method is the sect's secret method. Could this secret method be passed down by the saint? "
“Of course she is a saint. " Mentioning this, Hua Nongying's tone became more sincere and respectful, "This is the supreme secret method passed down by the ancestor, and ordinary disciples can't even hear its name. When I first entered the inner gate, I was severely ostracized. If the saint hadn't helped me, I would have been chewed to the point where no bones were left. "
When she said this, her eyes shone with genuine gratitude.
Li Hanshan did not answer the call.
The supreme secret method of the Patriarch?
He has practiced with Hua Nongying many times, and he knows better than anyone else how domineering that technique is.
Every time I take supplements, I want to absorb every drop of the essence of the furnace cauldron. He has been in the Hehuan Sect for some time, and knows that when other witches mend the furnace cauldron, they pay attention to the long flow of water and controlling the heat, so that the furnace cauldron can last longer and be more productive. But Hua Nongying's technique doesn't pay attention to these at all - it just sucks, sucking it to death.
Of course, no matter how overbearing this technique is, it is not as overbearing as Yang Ce.
But with such a secret method, the saintess of the Hehuan Sect can actually make flowers look like shadows. Is there some truth in this?
Li Hanshan didn't know what the specific situation was.
In the next few days, the Holy Lady of Hehuan Sect did not send anyone again, and Hua Nongying did not mention her anymore.
As for Li Hanshan, he still finds Hua Nongying to practice every few days.
During this process, he began to explore the in-depth application of Yangce Gongfa, and confirmed that the mysterious lines appearing on the abdomen were related to Yangce Gongfa.
"Her lines are concave, while mine are convex. The concave is yin and the convex is yang. It seems that she can't see the lines on my abdomen..."
Li Hanshan discovered a lot, such as the difference between the two lines, and the fact that the lines continued to deepen with the increase in practice.
Another discovery is that the energy drawn from the Yang Ce technique can be used not only to improve cultivation, but also to nourish the body. The effect is even better than Hua Nongying's medicinal soup.
This made him visit Hua Nongying more frequently.
"Damn it! Damn it! Li Hanshan, I must kill you! "
Every time Li Hanshan left, the gentle smile on Hua Nongying's face collapsed like melting ice and snow. She grabbed the pillow and threw it on the bed, her silver teeth clenching.
She hates it!
On Li Hanshan's side, after practicing for many days in a row, the spiritual power in his body was like a fire that was constantly adding firewood, burning more and more vigorously.
Finally, one night, a dull roar came from the dantian. The spiritual power that has been accumulated for a long time has reached a certain critical point, rushing like a tide in his meridians, opening up a broader cycle of heaven and earth along the way.
The third level of Qi refining!
He opened his eyes, a flash of surprise flashing across his eyes.
"This Yang Book is really against the heavens!"
Li Hanshan realized more and more the power of Yang Ce Kung Fu.
His preserves are my arsenic.
If other people's spiritual power is directly inhaled into one's own body, it will only bring destruction.
All the tonic techniques, in essence, use special methods to transform other people's spiritual energy into your own.
The better the technique, the higher the efficiency of transformation.
Obviously, Yang Ce is the highest kind.
Of course, Yang Book is essentially anti-plunder, but it can also be used to plunder, just like what Li Hanshan is doing now.
"He broke through again!"
Hua Nongying felt so bitter in her heart.
Even with supplements, Li Hanshan's breakthrough speed was too fast.
While this made her depressed, deep down in her heart she became even more enthusiastic about the technique that Li Hanshan cherished, and she wanted to get it even more.
However, if Li Hanshan continued to suck like this, she would never be able to break through the foundation, which made her more and more anxious.
"No, we can't go on like this."
Hua Nongying knew that she had to find a way to break the situation.
But with the Demon Oath in her heart, she really didn't dare to do anything else.
